adaptations.changes: Project own messages/tools; remove transformMessages/environment/SDK retries; explicit model binding controls reminder/cache TTL.

Own ArrivalEvent producer; no intermediate tool JSON parse; preserve provider/cost/opaque; length never closes blocks. Narrower than appendOpenAIReasoningDetail: adjacent reasoning.text fragments join only with equal non-text/non-signature members and one content-block identity: the same nonempty id, or no id on both (unsigned deltas join as before; when a signature is involved both must carry the same nonnegative integer index, per dispatcher ruling R-L after the paid Sonnet 5 receipt cecc12c9-300e-43db-8389-7bb4ac859d4f showed id-less same-index text then signature-only fragments). Within one identity an absent/null signature is filled once by a later nonempty one, equal signatures continue, a text-less fragment contributes only its nonempty signature, and an unsigned fragment after a signed one starts a new entry; encrypted details stay discrete.
Node IncomingMessage, strict lossless JSON, bounded UTF-8 framing, all SSE newline forms and explicit DONE.

Version openrouter-input-projection/2: one lossless code-point-sorted canonical encoding, scoped Anthropic generated 1h cache metadata exclusion, stable nonempty assistant/tool arrays from first request; no cross-shape token equivalence claim.
First-parsed usage/cost/input facts share one accumulator; X-OpenRouter-Cache-Status HIT never supplies an input-zero anchor. Rolling first-party docs; no model probe.
